linkedin.title: AZ Consultants Launches GitHub Enterprise Architecture Hub
linkedin.text:
We just leveled up.

AZ Consultants is officially expanding into a full GitHub Enterprise Architecture Hub:
👉 https://github.com/enterprises/az-consultants

For the last 6 months, we’ve been quietly benchmarking cloud infrastructure, fixing microsecond latency bottlenecks, and building zero-overhead developer tooling.

🚀 What we are launching during our 30-day enterprise sprint:
1. Battle-Tested Open Source: Production-grade engines like TurboBatch (adaptive concurrency, zero-dependency token-bucket batch processing).
2. Enterprise GitHub Actions & Security Shields: Pre-commit credential scanners and automated SOC2 policy linters.
3. The 45-Min Enterprise Architecture Audit: We are opening 10 free diagnostic audits this month for engineering teams scaling their cloud infra.

Whether you’re optimizing a 50-pod Kubernetes cluster or looking to slash your AWS/GCP bill by 30%, our enterprise repos and blueprints are open for you.

⭐️ Star our flagship repos and follow our Enterprise Hub: https://github.com/enterprises/az-consultants

#GitHubEnterprise #DevOps #CloudEngineering #OpenSource #SoftwareArchitecture #Kubernetes #TechLeadership
